zh.title: 紐西蘭商業委員會擬起訴紐西蘭航空 指其誤導旅客補償權利
zh.summary: 紐西蘭商業委員會指稱，航空公司對部分航班延誤或取消的補償說明低於法定標準。
body: 紐西蘭商業委員會11月19日表示，將依《公平交易法》在奧克蘭地方法院對紐西蘭航空提出刑事指控。委員會指稱，部分航班因航空公司可控制的原因延誤或取消時，旅客收到的補償說明可能造成誤解。
委員會稱，部分說明將補償上限訂得比法定上限低，另有說法限制部分費用的報銷。委員會認為，相關情形可能自2024年1月起發生。
紐西蘭航空在聲明中表示，調查指出少數個案的溝通可更清楚，或其補償政策未依原意執行。相關指控仍待司法程序處理。

en.title: New Zealand regulator to bring charges against Air New Zealand over passenger compensation
en.summary: The Commerce Commission alleges that some passengers received misleading information about compensation for disruptions within the airline’s control.
body: New Zealand’s Commerce Commission said on November 19 it would file Fair Trading Act charges against Air New Zealand in Auckland District Court. It alleges that passengers received misleading information about compensation for disruptions within the airline’s control.
The regulator said some statements described caps below statutory limits or restricted reimbursement for certain expenses. It believes the conduct may date back to January 2024.

Air New Zealand said the investigation identified a small number of cases where its communications could have been clearer or its policies were not applied as intended. The allegations are subject to court proceedings.

facts.claim: The regulator says it will file charges in Auckland District Court.
It alleges misleading representations about compensation after disruptions within the airline’s control.
The regulator believes the alleged conduct may date back to January 2024.
